label: Amazon, zooming
source: Round 14 rzoom: tools/gesture/results/rzoom-4-ornament.recipe.json, panels[0] (1491); any-line resource: tools/gesture/results/lcorp-2026-10-19.md
notes: The favourite top-row strip: three uneven pushes into the real Amazon stem, each pulled quickly back out, on a free course. Every heading is the river’s own. Adapted from 600 × 150 to a plottable 300 × 110 mm frame; a single constant 0.3 mm wire replaces the research recipe’s variable-width bands. Ian: "amazing"; wants this "as a tool/gesture/resource to be called", on other hands too. The frozen lcorp_zoom voice and lcorp_zoom_mod modulator generalise this operation to hand chains, relays, trails or any voice. The sibling hand.recipe.json is a callable dancer_cristel example for the recipe editor; the study keeps the exact river mechanism. Controls: schedule, number of pushes, magnification, start and share along the stem, schedule pace and seed. Course is fixed free; width stays constant.

controls.label: Pushes / repetitions
controls.help: Acts for push, pulses, drift, steps and breath; other schedules have one fixed event.

controls.label: Schedule pace
controls.help: 0 keys zoom to the drawn line; 1 keys it to the river.
